stories.hook: ¿Puede la terapia mejorar la función ocupacional en depresión?
stories.headline: Intervenciones psiquiátricas mejoran notablemente la función ocupacional en depresión y ansiedad
stories.finding: El estudio mostró una mejora significativa en la capacidad de los pacientes para realizar tareas cotidianas, como higiene personal, trabajo y actividades sociales, tras recibir farmacoterapia y psicoterapia. Estos resultados resaltan el valor de un abordaje multidisciplinario para reducir la disfunción ocupacional.
stories.takeaway: Este dato sugiere que combinar fármacos y terapia psicológica puede restaurar la participación laboral y social, orientando a clínicos a priorizar intervenciones integradas en MDD y trastornos de ansiedad.
stories.paperTitle: Evaluating the Efficacy of Psychiatric Interventions on Occupational Dysfunction in Major Depressive and Anxiety Disorder Patients
stories.originalAbstract: This study investigates the impact of psychiatric interventions on occupational dysfunction in patients with major depressive disorder (MDD) and anxiety disorder (AD). Occupational dysfunction is a significant concern in these populations, severely impairing the ability to perform daily activities and fulfill work and social roles. This research seeks to evaluate how different psychiatric interventions, including pharmacotherapy and psychotherapy, affect patients’ occupational performance and overall quality of life. This study analyzed data from outpatients diagnosed with MDD and AD based on ICD-10 criteria. Participants were assessed before and after intervention using scales that measure anxiety, depression, and occupational task difficulty. Results demonstrated a significant improvement in patients’ ability to perform a wide range of tasks, including personal hygiene, work-related activities, and social engagement, following treatment. The study highlights the importance of a multidisciplinary approach, emphasizing that both pharmacotherapy and psychotherapy significantly contribute to reducing occupational dysfunction and enhancing quality of life. These findings underscore the need for tailored interventions that address the specific occupational challenges faced by individuals with MDD and AD, aiming for long-term functional recovery.

stories.hook: ¿Puede la ATT frenar la rumiación crónica?
stories.headline: La técnica de entrenamiento atencional muestra eficacia general contra la rumiación
stories.finding: La revisión sistemática incluyó 33 estudios que evaluaron la ATT y encontró que, en general, la técnica reduce los patrones de pensamiento repetitivo y mejora la flexibilidad ejecutiva. Sin embargo, su ventaja sobre grupos de control activos es variable según el contexto.
stories.takeaway: Este hallazgo sugiere que la ATT es una herramienta prometedora para intervenir en la rumiación, pero los clínicos deben considerar la naturaleza del control comparativo al diseñar tratamientos.
stories.paperTitle: Üstbilişsel Terapi Stratejisi Olarak Dikkat Eğitimi Tekniğinin Etkililiği: Sistematik Bir Gözden Geçirme
stories.originalAbstract: Dikkat Eğitimi Tekniği (Attention Training Technique – ATT), düşüncelere mesafeli farkındalığı artırmayı, tekrarlayıcı düşünme kalıplarını bozmayı ve yürütücü işlevlerde esnekliği artırmayı amaçlayan kısa süreli bir üstbilişsel terapi stratejisidir. Bu çalışma, söz konusu tekniğin farklı örneklemler üzerindeki etkililiğini değerlendiren araştırmaları sistematik olarak gözden geçirmeyi amaçlamaktadır. Bu kapsamda, “Attention training technique” anahtar kelimesi kullanılarak PsycINFO, Scopus, Web of Science ve PubMED veri tabanlarında yayımlanmış çalışmalar taranmıştır. Bu gözden geçirme çalışmasına belirli dahil etme kriterlerine dayanarak, toplam 33 etkililik çalışması (söz konusu veri tabanlarından elde edilen 30 ve diğer kaynaklardan 3 çalışma) dâhil edilmiştir. Bulgular; örneklem özellikleri, kontrol ve karşılaştırma koşulları, gruplara atama yöntemleri, ölçüm araçları, ölçüm sıklığı, seans özellikleri, çalışma sonuçları ve yanlılık riskinin değerlendirilmesi temelinde özetlenmiştir. Farklı örneklemler ve bağlamlarda elde edilen sonuçlar, ATT’nin genel olarak etkili olduğunu göstermektedir; ancak bu etkililik, aktif müdahale içeren kontrol gruplarıyla karşılaştırıldığında bazı ölçümlerle sınırlı kalmaktadır. Buna karşın, bekleme listesi veya bir müdahale uygulanmayan kontrol gruplarıyla yapılan karşılaştırmalarda daha belirgin ve anlamlı farklılıklar ortaya çıkmıştır. ATT, temelde üstbilişsel terapinin bir bileşeni olarak değerlendirilse de mevcut kanıtlar bu tekniğin tek başına uygulandığında da etkili olduğunu göstermektedir. Ayrıca, incelenen çalışmalar ATT’nin farklı terapi yaklaşımlarına entegre edilmesiyle de etkili sonuçlar verdiğini ortaya koymaktadır. Bağımsız değerlendiricilerin kullanıldığı, farklı örneklem gruplarının dâhil edildiği, farklı seans sayıları ve değişkenlerin test edildiği, ayrıca daha uzun izlem sürelerinin uygulandığı gelecek araştırmaların, ATT’nin etkililiğine katkı sunacağı düşünülmektedir.

stories.hook: ¿Puede el ejercicio reducir la adicción a redes sociales?
stories.headline: El ejercicio disminuye la adicción a redes sociales mediante ansiedad y agotamiento del ego
stories.finding: En una muestra de 1,174 adolescentes chinos, la actividad física mostró correlaciones negativas con la adicción a redes sociales (r = -0.165), la ansiedad (r = -0.121) y el agotamiento del ego (r = -0.119). Además, la ansiedad y el agotamiento del ego mediaron secuencialmente la relación entre actividad física y adicción, indicando que mayor ejercicio reduce la adicción al disminuir la ansiedad y el agotamiento.
stories.takeaway: Este hallazgo sugiere que promover la actividad física en adolescentes puede ser una estrategia preventiva eficaz contra la adicción a redes sociales, al actuar sobre mecanismos psicológicos como la ansiedad y el agotamiento cognitivo.
stories.paperTitle: The relationship between physical activity and social network site addiction among adolescents: the chain mediating role of anxiety and ego-depletion
stories.originalAbstract: BACKGROUND AND OBJECTIVES: Physical activity is associated with social network site addiction in adolescents, yet the mechanisms remain unclear. This study examines whether anxiety and ego-depletion mediate this relationship. METHODS: A survey was conducted among 1,174 Chinese adolescents (614 boys, 560 girls; mean age = 12.59, SD = 1.13). Physical activity was assessed with a single item on moderate-to-vigorous exercise in the past 7 days. Social network site addiction, anxiety, and ego-depletion were measured using validated self-report questionnaires. Descriptive statistics, correlation analyses, and a chained mediation model were employed. RESULTS: Physical activity was negatively correlated with social network site addiction (r = -0.165, p < 0.001), anxiety (r = -0.121, p < 0.001), and ego-depletion (r = -0.119, p < 0.001). Anxiety was positively correlated with ego-depletion (r = 0.574, p < 0.001) and social network site addiction (r = 0.388, p < 0.001). Ego-depletion was positively associated with social network site addiction (r = 0.456, p < 0.001). Anxiety and ego-depletion sequentially mediated the relationship between physical activity and social network site addiction. CONCLUSION: This study clarifies the psychological mechanisms linking physical activity and social network site addiction in adolescents, identifying anxiety and ego-depletion as key mediators. The findings emphasize the need to target these factors for more effective interventions.

stories.hook: ¿Qué componentes del CBT‑I son realmente esenciales?
stories.headline: Componentes y formatos del CBT‑I que maximizan la remisión del insomnio
stories.finding: Una revisión sistemática con metaanálisis de red de componentes evaluó distintas estrategias y modos de entrega del CBT‑I en adultos con insomnio crónico. Los resultados mostraron que ciertos componentes y formatos específicos se asocian significativamente con mayor eficacia terapéutica.
stories.takeaway: Identificar los componentes y formatos más efectivos permite optimizar la intervención, mejorar la remisión del insomnio y guiar la práctica clínica y la planificación de servicios de salud mental.
stories.paperTitle: Components and Delivery Formats of Cognitive Behavioral Therapy for Chronic Insomnia in Adults: A Systematic Review and Component Network Meta-Analysis
stories.originalAbstract: Importance: Chronic insomnia disorder is highly prevalent, disabling, and costly. Cognitive behavioral therapy for insomnia (CBT-I), comprising various educational, cognitive, and behavioral strategies delivered in various formats, is the recommended first-line treatment, but the effect of each component and delivery method remains unclear. Objective: To examine the association of each component and delivery format of CBT-I with outcomes. Data Sources: PubMed, Cochrane Central Register of Controlled Trials, PsycInfo, and International Clinical Trials Registry Platform from database inception to July 21, 2023. Study Selection: Published randomized clinical trials comparing any form of CBT-I against another or a control condition for chronic insomnia disorder in adults aged 18 years and older. Insomnia both with and without comorbidities was included. Concomitant treatments were allowed if equally distributed among arms. Data Extraction and Synthesis: Two independent reviewers identified components, extracted data, and assessed trial quality. Random-effects component network meta-analyses were performed. Main Outcomes and Measures: The primary outcome was treatment efficacy (remission defined as reaching a satisfactory state) posttreatment. Secondary outcomes included all-cause dropout, self-reported sleep continuity, and long-term remission. Results: A total of 241 trials were identified including 31 452 participants (mean [SD] age, 45.4 [16.6] years; 21 048 of 31 452 [67%] women). Results suggested that critical components of CBT-I are cognitive restructuring (remission incremental odds ratio [iOR], 1.68; 95% CI, 1.28-2.20) third-wave components (iOR, 1.49; 95% CI, 1.10-2.03), sleep restriction (iOR, 1.49; 95% CI, 1.04-2.13), and stimulus control (iOR, 1.43; 95% CI, 1.00-2.05). Sleep hygiene education was not essential (iOR, 1.01; 95% CI, 0.77-1.32), and relaxation procedures were found to be potentially counterproductive(iOR, 0.81; 95% CI, 0.64-1.02). In-person therapist-led programs were most beneficial (iOR, 1.83; 95% CI, 1.19-2.81). Cognitive restructuring, third-wave components, and in-person delivery were mainly associated with improved subjective sleep quality. Sleep restriction was associated with improved subjective sleep quality, sleep efficiency, and wake after sleep onset, and stimulus control with improved subjective sleep quality, sleep efficiency, and sleep latency. The most efficacious combination-consisting of cognitive restructuring, third wave, sleep restriction, and stimulus control in the in-person format-compared with in-person psychoeducation, was associated with an increase in the remission rate by a risk difference of 0.33 (95% CI, 0.23-0.43) and a number needed to treat of 3.0 (95% CI, 2.3-4.3), given the median observed control event rate of 0.14. Conclusions and Relevance: The findings suggest that beneficial CBT-I packages may include cognitive restructuring, third-wave components, sleep restriction, stimulus control, and in-person delivery but not relaxation. However, potential undetected interactions could undermine the conclusions. Further large-scale, well-designed trials are warranted to confirm the contribution of different treatment components in CBT-I.

stories.hook: ¿Puede la alexitimia predecir el trauma y el apego?
stories.headline: Alexitimia como factor de riesgo transdiagnóstico vinculado al trauma y apego
stories.finding: The authors defend the original alexithymia construct, emphasizing the reduced imaginal activity component omitted in the attention‑appraisal model. They report that alexithymia correlates with emotional distress, emotion‑regulation difficulties, insecure attachment, and trauma, suggesting it may act as a transdiagnostic risk factor.
stories.takeaway: Reconocer la alexitimia como indicador de vulnerabilidad al trauma y a patrones de apego inseguros orienta la evaluación clínica y favorece intervenciones tempranas que integren trabajo emocional e imaginería, mejorando resultados terapéuticos.
stories.paperTitle: Alexithymia: A Defense of the Original Conceptualization of the Construct and a Critique of the Attention-Appraisal Model.
stories.originalAbstract: Objective: Our goal was to compare the original conceptualization of the alexithymia construct with the attention-appraisal model, focusing primarily on the removal of the reduced imaginal activity component, a seminal aspect of the construct in the original model. We also examined associations between alexithymia and emotional distress and emotion regulation, attachment, and trauma, and whether alexithymia is a transdiagnostic risk factor. We discuss differences between the models in the treatment of alexithymia and also differences in measurement. Method: We conducted a narrative review of the scientific literature validating the original model of alexithymia and examined the comparatively few empirical studies evaluating the attention-appraisal model. Articles describing contemporary theoretical ideas about the relationship between imagination and emotion were reviewed, as well as studies exploring associations between alexithymia and imaginal activity. Results: The attention-appraisal model of alexithymia is theoretically derived and examined empirically in studies using correlation/measurement-based methods that employed self-report measures with mostly non-clinical samples and conducted primarily by researchers led by developers of the model. The original model of alexithymia is derived from observations of patients in clinical settings; its validity is supported by findings from hundreds of empirical investigations spanning nearly four decades with nonclinical and a variety of clinical samples using both correlation-based and experimental studies and methods of measurement other than self-report, and by independent teams of researchers. The reduced imaginal activity component of the alexithymia construct is mostly supported by these studies. Conclusions: Because of the dearth of studies with clinical samples, the absence of investigations by independent researchers, and the limited range of methods and measurements to evaluate and assess the model, there is insufficient evidence to warrant removal of the imaginal activity component of the alexithymia construct and for replacing the original conceptualization of the construct with the attention-appraisal model.

stories.headline: Las fantasías sexuales predicen estrategias de afrontamiento y agresión intrapsíquica
stories.finding: En una encuesta con N = 401, el modelado por ecuaciones estructurales mostró que el afrontamiento progresivo (p. ej., dependencia o autoestima) se relacionó con fantasías sexuales de agresión externa (β = .26; .42) y auto‑dirigida (β = .23; .22). El afrontamiento regresivo (p. ej., culpa) se asoció principalmente con fantasías de agresión externa (β = .38; .41).
stories.takeaway: Este hallazgo valida empíricamente la hipótesis psicoanalítica de que las fantasías sexuales reflejan conflictos intrapsíquicos y estilos de afrontamiento, ofreciendo a los clínicos una herramienta potencial para inferir dinámicas inconscientes a partir del contenido fantasioso.
stories.paperTitle: Sexual fantasies as unique pathway to understanding psychodynamics – do our theories pass the empirical test?
stories.originalAbstract: Psychoanalytical theories have always linked intrapsychic conflict to psychosexuality. One’s sexual fantasy is commonly understood as non-consciously representing past (un-)pleasurable experiences, object relations, and intrapsychic conflict, granting unique access to an individual’s psychodynamic. We subjected this idea to empirical testing by assessing intrapsychic conflicts and sexual fantasies in an anonymous online-survey (N = 401). Structural-equation-modeling was used to analyze the data. Respondents using more progressive coping strategies, e.g. for dependency or self-worth conflict, showed more sexual fantasies with externally directed (β = .26; β = .42) and self-directed aggression (β = .23; β = .22). While externally directed aggression is typical in progressively coping individuals, self-directed aggression typically is repressed. Regressive coping, e.g. with self-worth or guilt conflict, was predominantly linked to sexual fantasies with externally directed aggression (β = .38; β = .41), which is typically repressed in regressively coping individuals. These findings underline the clinical value of exploring sexual fantasies as they might help establish access to repressed aggressive strivings. Furthermore, conflicts emerging later in development, such as self-worth and oedipal conflicts, showed stronger associations with aggression-related sexual fantasies, suggesting that better personality functioning might facilitate integrating aggressive and libidinal impulses, and regulating them intrapsychically within sexual fantasies. Our findings provide initial evidence supporting psychoanalytic theory and encourage further interdisciplinary research.

stories.hook: ¿Cómo influye la intolerancia al malestar en el juego?
stories.headline: Intolerancia al malestar y estrategias emocionales predicen juego en tiempo real
stories.finding: En una muestra de 132 adultos australianos, la intolerancia momentánea al malestar aumentó la duración de las sesiones de juego (OR = 1.13, IC 95 % [1.02, 1.25], p = .024). Además, el uso de estrategias emocionales maladaptativas se asoció a mayor probabilidad de episodios de juego (OR = 1.24, p = .023).
stories.takeaway: Estos hallazgos sugieren que intervenir la intolerancia al malestar y promover estrategias emocionales adaptativas podría reducir la intensidad y frecuencia del juego, ofreciendo una vía concreta para tratamientos de adicción basados en la regulación emocional en tiempo real.
stories.paperTitle: Exploring real-time associations between momentary distress tolerance, emotion regulation, and gambling behavior in Australian adults: An Ecological Momentary Assessment Study.
stories.originalAbstract: Objective: Guided by the dynamic model of relapse, this study examined whether momentary distress intolerance (DI) and emotion regulation (ER; maladaptive and adaptive strategy use) predict gambling behavior (episodes, expenditure, duration) in real time and whether momentary DI and ER interact with each other and with stable (problem gambling severity, high-risk situations) and momentary (psychological distress, state impulsivity) vulnerabilities in predicting gambling episodes.Method: A secondary analysis was conducted on an ecological momentary assessment (EMA) study comprising a pre-EMA survey of stable variables followed by a 28-day period of twice-daily smartphone-delivered EMAs of momentary variables and gambling episodes.The convenience sample included 132 Australian adults (M age = 29.9years; 58.3% male; 94.7% endorsed gambling problems) who reported gambling in a typical month.Results: Mixed-effects logistic regression analyses showed that momentary DI was associated with longer subsequent gambling duration (OR = 1.13, 95% CI [1.02, 1.25], p = .024),and maladaptive ER strategies were associated with both gambling episodes (OR = 1.24, 95% CI [1.03, 1.50], p = .023)and longer subsequent gambling duration (OR = 1.64, 95% CI [1.02, 2.65], p = .042).Adaptive ER strategy use was not significantly associated with gambling behavior.Only DI interacted with state impulsivity (OR = 1.11, 95% CI [1.03, 1.19], p = .005),whereby individuals with low impulsivity were more likely to gamble when DI was low, whereas those with high impulsivity were more likely to gamble when DI was high.Conclusions: These findings contribute to our understanding of DI and ER strategy use as dynamic, momentary vulnerabilities for gambling behavior and highlight their potential as real-time intervention targets, particularly for individuals with high impulsivity. stories.hook: ¿Actigrafía detecta diferencias entre esquizofrenia y controles?
stories.headline: Actigrafía y aprendizaje automático distinguen esquizofrenia y espectro bipolar de controles
stories.finding: Los modelos que combinan características actigráficas detalladas distinguieron con mayor precisión a los grupos de esquizofrenia y espectro bipolar de controles, superando a los modelos basados en medidas de actividad simples. En el grupo ciclotímico, la actividad durante el descanso, la organización diaria y los movimientos nocturnos fueron distintivos.
stories.takeaway: Esta evidencia sugiere que la actigrafía, combinada con aprendizaje automático, puede ofrecer biomarcadores objetivos para el diagnóstico diferencial y la monitorización de la gravedad en trastornos psicóticos y bipolares.
stories.paperTitle: Actigraphic Assessment of Psychomotor Patterns Associated with the Schizophrenia and Bipolar Spectra
stories.journal: SZTE Repository of Dissertations (University of Szeged)
stories.originalAbstract: Psychomotor alterations may represent an important symptom dimension of major psychiatric disorders. Actigraphy enables the objective assessment of motor activity and rest–activity rhythms in naturalistic settings. The aim of this dissertation was to investigate psychomotor patterns associated with the schizophrenia and bipolar spectra using detailed actigraphic feature extraction and machine learning methods. The dissertation is based on two cross-sectional studies. In the first study, we examined the actigraphic profiles of individuals without a psychiatric diagnosis who were characterised by cyclothymic temperament (CFG) or positive schizotypal traits (PSF), compared with controls. In the second study, using two independent databases, we analysed the model patterns of the PSF group and individuals with chronic schizophrenia (CS), each relative to their respective control group. Models based on combinations of detailed actigraphic features distinguished the psychometric groups from controls more accurately than models based on simple activity measures. In the CFG group, activity during the rest period, the organisation of daily activity, and characteristics of nocturnal movements emerged as important features. In the PSF group, fine temporal and amplitude-based characteristics of movements during sleep contributed primarily to classification in both studies. In chronic schizophrenia, a broader range of daytime activity and rest–activity rhythm measures contributed alongside nocturnal movement features. Our findings demonstrate that detailed actigraphic feature extraction combined with machine learning enables the identification of psychomotor patterns beyond those captured by conventional activity measures.

stories.headline: Nueva definición de mindfulness integra atención y aceptación
stories.finding: Los autores revisan definiciones budistas y psicológicas, identificando componentes centrales como la conciencia del momento presente y la actitud de aceptación sin juicio. Proponen una definición refinada que unifica estos elementos para mejorar la medición y la comparabilidad de estudios.
stories.takeaway: Una definición consensuada facilita la creación de instrumentos válidos y la integración de mindfulness en intervenciones clínicas, potenciando su efectividad y la comparabilidad de resultados.
stories.paperTitle: Defining Mindfulness: A Review of Existing Definitions and Suggested Refinements
stories.originalAbstract: Abstract Objectives Mindfulness research is hampered by the multiplicity of definitions of mindfulness. This heterogeneity, as reflected in the variability of mindfulness scales, limits the ability to generalize findings and hinders attempts to synthesize available studies. This paper explores traditional and contemporary definitions of mindfulness, aiming to extract core components and provide a refined and clearly specified definition suitable for underpinning measurement in psychological science. Method This narrative review broadly analyzes and synthesizes the conceptual frameworks across various definitions of mindfulness to identify core components of mindfulness within Buddhist and psychological science literature. Results Traditional Buddhist definitions of mindfulness focus on (a) memory and remembrance, (b) present-centered awareness, and (c) ethicality, but lack conceptual commonality due to the diversity of Buddhist schools and to the intricate context in which mindfulness is embedded. Definitions in psychological science show greater conceptual agreement and emphasize (a) present-centered awareness and bare attention, and (b) attitudes of acceptance and non-judgment. Conclusions Taken together, there is a lack of conceptual commonality and clarity on mindfulness definitions, to the extent that it may be challenging to propose a single definition that fully encapsulates both Buddhist and psychological science perspectives. For the purposes of psychological science, refinements are suggested by (a) including four scopes of mindfulness that clarify present-centeredness as awareness of and attention to body sensations, affective valence (i.e., pleasant, unpleasant, neutral), cognition and emotional states (including impulses and action tendencies), and the external environment (i.e., external sensory experience and interpersonal interactions); and (b) emphasizing the allowing and equanimous attitudes as the key qualities of mindfulness. Mindfulness is therefore defined as: “present-centered awareness of and bare attention to body sensations, affective valence, cognitive and emotional phenomena, and the external environment with an allowing and equanimous attitude.” Preregistration The study is not preregistered.

stories.hook: ¿Por qué los estudiantes senior sienten más impostor?
stories.headline: Más de la mitad de estudiantes de ciencias del deporte presentan síndrome del impostor
stories.finding: En una muestra de 289 estudiantes de ciencias del deporte, el 52,6 % reportó características frecuentes o intensas de impostor (CIPS = 62,1 ± 12,9). El modelo de regresión mostró que ser estudiante de último año se asoció significativamente con puntuaciones mayores (b = 5,6).
stories.takeaway: Este hallazgo evidencia la alta prevalencia del síndrome del impostor en estudiantes de deporte, lo que sugiere la necesidad de intervenciones de autoestima y compasión para prevenir deterioro del bienestar y rendimiento académico.
stories.paperTitle: The association of competitiveness and sociodemographics with imposter phenomenon in a cohort of sport science college undergraduates
stories.originalAbstract: INTRODUCTION: Imposter phenomenon is where individuals experience continued feelings of self-doubt, with fears of being exposed as frauds. The intersectionality of different identities related to imposter phenomenon has rarely been examined in sport science student populations. This study examines the prevalence of imposter phenomenon among sport science undergraduate students and explores differences between different sociodemographic groups. METHODS: This secondary analysis study examines 289 undergraduate students in a sport science course at a United States Southeastern university from Spring 2023 to Spring 2025. The Clance Imposter Phenomenon Scale (CIPS) measured imposter phenomenon, and the Revised Competitiveness Index (CI-R) examined competitiveness. Multiple linear regression examined associations of imposter phenomenon with sociodemographic variables and competitiveness subscales (enjoyment of competition, contentiousness). RESULTS: Overall, 52.6% of students reported frequent or intense imposter characteristics (CIPS mean±SD = 62.1 ± 12.9). In the final model (adjusted r² = 26.7%), significant predictors included: being a senior versus first-year/sophomore (b = 5.6; 95%CI: 2.1, 9.2); and higher contentiousness (10%-increase-b = -1.5; 95%CI: -2.0, -0.9). Interaction terms included gender identity × first generation student status (p = 0.02) and varsity athlete × enjoyment of competition (p = 0.06). Among first generation students, those not identifying as men had higher imposter phenomenon than men (b = 7.4; 95%CI: 4.2, 10.6); among non-first generation students, no differences were found (b = -1.3; 95%CI: -7.9, 5.2). Among varsity athletes, for every 10% increase in the enjoyment of competition subscale, imposter phenomenon scores decreased by 2.1 (95%CI: -4.4, 0.1); among non-varsity athletes, enjoyment of competition was not associated with imposter phenomenon scores (10%-increase-b = 0.1; 95%CI: -0.7, 0.8). DISCUSSION: Over half of the sample noted frequent and intense feelings of imposter phenomenon. Helping students consider their capabilities and potential for future success, despite academic setbacks, should be considered in resources to mitigate imposter phenomenon. Resources throughout a student's college tenure can help address imposter phenomenon at various stages of academic and professional development.

stories.hook: ¿Qué demandas laborales realmente dañan al personal de salud?
stories.headline: Demandas de obstáculo y amenaza perjudican más la salud mental que las demandas de desafío
stories.finding: Un meta‑análisis prospectivo de 47 muestras (N = 39 467) de empleados sanitarios europeos mostró que las demandas de obstáculo y de amenaza son más perjudiciales para el bienestar que las demandas de desafío. Además, los recursos iniciales, sobre todo a nivel grupal, protegieron y favorecieron el bienestar posterior.
stories.takeaway: Este hallazgo indica que reducir demandas de obstáculo y amenaza y fortalecer recursos grupales puede ser clave para preservar el bienestar del personal sanitario, orientando intervenciones organizacionales y políticas de gestión del trabajo.
stories.paperTitle: Job demands and resources and their association with employee well-being in the European healthcare sector: a systematic review and meta-analysis of prospective research
stories.originalAbstract: Despite the extant research on work and well-being in the healthcare sector, a comprehensive overview of the key work characteristics, and a meta-analytic investigation of their over-time relationships with well-being, are still lacking. This study provides (1) a summary of the most investigated job demands and resources at the group, leadership, and organisation levels (GLO) explored in the European healthcare sector; (2) a quantitative analysis of their prospective association with well-being; (3) a test of the moderator effect of work characteristics’ source (GLO) and time lag. A systematic literature search was completed resulting in 47 independent samples (N = 39,467 healthcare employees). We identified a wide range of challenge (i.e. workload), hindrance (i.e. role stress), threat demands (i.e. violence from patients) and resources (i.e. control, support). Meta-analytic results showed that hindrance and threat demands were more detrimental than challenge demands, but unexpectedly challenge demands were not related to motivational outcomes. Baseline resources had an important role in protecting and promoting follow-up employee well-being, with group-level resources being more strongly negatively associated with strain. We found no significant differences in well-being between GLO levels of job demands. Time lag did not significantly moderate the prospective associations among work characteristics and employee well-being.

stories.hook: ¿Ocultar emociones con la pareja afecta tu desempeño laboral?
stories.headline: Actuar superficialmente con la pareja genera alienación en el trabajo, sobre todo en líderes maquiavélicos
stories.finding: En un estudio longitudinal con tres oleadas semanales y 226 líderes estadounidenses, suprimir emociones negativas con la pareja (T1) se relacionó con mayor auto‑alienación en el trabajo (T3) mediante la frustración de la necesidad de relación (T2). Este efecto indirecto fue más fuerte en líderes con alto maquiavelismo.
stories.takeaway: El hallazgo muestra que ocultar emociones con la pareja perjudica el rendimiento laboral, sobre todo en líderes maquiavélicos, indicando que las intervenciones de desarrollo de liderazgo deben abordar la regulación emocional familiar y la influencia de rasgos de personalidad.
stories.paperTitle: The nonwork-work spillover effects of leaders' spouse-directed surface acting: implications for self-alienation at work and the role of Machiavellianism
stories.originalAbstract: Purpose Guided by the work-home resources model while integrating basic needs theory, the present study examined how spouse-directed surface acting in the nonwork domain spills over into the work domain. Design/methodology/approach Three time-lagged waves of weekly data from 226 US leaders were analyzed using first-stage moderated mediation analysis with 5,000 bootstrapped resamples in R software. Findings Results from the bootstrapped moderated mediation model revealed that suppressing negative emotions with one's spouse at Time 1 was positively linked to self-alienation at work at Time 3 via the frustration of relatedness needs with one's spouse at Time 2. Moreover, this indirect effect (as well the direct effect between suppressing negative emotions and relatedness frustration) was, contravening our predictions, stronger for leaders higher in Machiavellianism. Originality/value This research is among the first to document the negative spillover effects of spouse-directed surface acting, revealing that suppressing negative emotions may be a catalyst for such spillover. Furthermore, our work builds upon extant knowledge of Machiavellianism in intimate partnerships, suggesting that while Machs may surface act with their partners more, they may particularly be vulnerable to the effects of negative emotion suppression.

stories.hook: ¿Puede la terapia reducir la violencia de individuos autistas?
stories.headline: Intervenciones psicológicas disminuyen vulnerabilidades violentas en autismo
stories.finding: El análisis de 18 estudios, de los cuales solo dos evaluaron intervenciones específicas para personas con TEA, mostró que la intervención Diamant y la complejidad integradora produjeron mejoras modestas pero consistentes en vulnerabilidades del TEA. Estas mejoras incluyeron mayor tolerancia a la ambigüedad, flexibilidad cognitiva y actitudes menos extremistas.
stories.takeaway: Este hallazgo sugiere que intervenciones psicológicas adaptadas al neurodesarrollo pueden ser una herramienta preventiva clave para reducir el riesgo de violencia motivada por agravios en personas autistas, orientando políticas de salud mental y seguridad pública.
stories.paperTitle: Autism and lone-actor grievance-fueled violence: A rapid evidence assessment of best practice psychological treatment.
stories.journal: Journal of Threat Assessment and Management
stories.originalAbstract: Lone-actor grievance-fueled violence presents a growing challenge for security and mental health systems, with emerging evidence suggesting individuals with autism spectrum disorder may be disproportionately represented in this offender group.This rapid evidence assessment (REA) synthesizes current research on psychological interventions aimed at reducing loneactor grievance-fueled violence risk in individuals with autism spectrum disorder.Eighteen studies were reviewed, but only two directly evaluated interventions tailored for autistic individuals.Most studies were methodologically weak, lacked manualized interventions, and offered limited empirical data.Programs such as the Diamant resilience intervention and integrative complexity showed promising results with modest but consistent improvements in autism spectrum disorder-specific vulnerabilities such as tolerance of ambiguity, cognitive flexibility, and attitudes associated with violent extremism.The findings highlight a critical need for high-quality, trauma-informed, neurodiversity affirming research to guide clinical practice, policy, and future intervention development to ethically and effectively address the risk of lone-actor grievance-fueled violence in neurodivergent individuals. Public Significance StatementAutistic individuals are increasingly encountered within threat assessment and fixated threat pathways for lone-actor grievance-fueled violence, yet there is little evidence to guide psychologically informed intervention.This review found that current responses predominantly emphasize monitoring and case management, while available psychological interventions inconsistently target the grievance fixation, cognitive rigidity, and social-emotional vulnerabilities central to autism-related risk formulations.The findings highlight a critical need for formulation-driven, autism-informed psychological treatment integrated within structured professional judgment and multidisciplinary threat assessment frameworks.

stories.hook: ¿Pueden las apps de armario mejorar tu salud mental?
stories.headline: Apps de gestión de armario reducen el consumo de moda y la ansiedad
stories.finding: El estudio analizó 27 aplicaciones de gestión de armario y 5 953 reseñas de usuarios en Apple y Google Play. De esas reseñas, 470 usuarios reportaron cambios conductuales que disminuyeron el consumo excesivo y 210 describieron beneficios psicológicos como mayor claridad mental y menor ansiedad.
stories.takeaway: Este hallazgo sugiere que herramientas digitales de organización pueden ser intervenciones de bajo costo para fomentar la sostenibilidad de la moda y mejorar el bienestar emocional, ofreciendo una vía práctica para profesionales de salud mental y políticas de consumo responsable.
stories.paperTitle: Wardrobe Management Apps and Their Unintended Benefits for Fashion Sustainability and Well-Being: Insights from User Reviews
stories.originalAbstract: Global clothing production and waste continues to increase while garment utilisation is decreasing. Many consumers wear only a fraction of the clothing they own, often forgetting or overlooking items already in their wardrobes. This disconnection from existing garments encourages unnecessary purchases and contributes to the environmental and psychological burden of fashion overconsumption. The purpose of this study was to explore the role of wardrobe management apps (WMAs) and their potential for reducing fashion overconsumption. This paper has two core aims: first, to assess how WMAs contribute to sustainability through organisation, extended use, and behavioural change, and second, to examine their emotional and practical benefits for users. A content analysis of 27 WMAs was conducted alongside a thematic analysis of all 5953 user reviews from Apple and Google Play stores. Our analysis showed that 470 users reported behavioural shifts related to reduced overconsumption and increased garment utilisation, while a further 210 users described psychological benefits such as improved mental clarity and reduced anxiety. These results demonstrate the potential of WMAs to support more sustainable fashion habits and enhanced consumer well-being, offering a digital means to promote responsible consumption and align with the UN Sustainable Development Goals, especially SDG 12.

stories.headline: Alto confort religioso se asocia a mayor presencia de sentido vital tras mortinato
stories.finding: Las mujeres que vivieron un mortinato mostraron alto confort religioso, nivel medio de culpa‑miedo, bajo de emociones negativas hacia Dios y mayor presencia de sentido vital que búsqueda de sentido. stories.paperTitle: The Role of Religious Comfort and Religious Struggles in Shaping the Meaning in Life in Polish Women after Stillbirth
stories.journal: Elementary Education in Theory and Practice (Jesuit University of Philosophy and Education Ignatianum)
stories.originalAbstract: Objective of the study: Religion often plays a positive role when a person goes through difficult experiences. The study aimed to show the role of religious comfort and religious struggles in shaping the presence and search for meaning in life in the lives of believing and practicing women after stillbirth. Method: The study was conducted in Poland. Sixty-four women who experienced the loss of a child as a result of a stillbirth that occurred after the 22nd week of pregnancy participated in the study. The following measurement instruments were used: The Religious Comfort and Strain Scale (RCSS) and The Meaning in Life Questionnaire (MLQ). Results: The analysis shows that women after stillbirth manifest a high level of religious comfort, a medium level of fear-guilt, negative emotions towards God, and a low level of negative social interaction around religion. They present a higher level of the presence of meaning in life than the search for meaning in life. In addition, in women’s lives, religious comfort has a significant and strong positive relationship with fear-guilt and a negative relationship with negative emotions toward God. Regression analysis shows that religious comfort, negative ­emotions toward God, and negative social interactions around religion have a stronger, more significant relationship with the search for meaning in life than with the presence of meaning in life. Moreover, as the model indicates, religious comfort has a direct, positive, and stronger relationship with the presence of meaning in life than with the search for it. Furthermore, religious comfort is positively related only to negative social interactions related to religion, which play a mediating role and are positively related more strongly to the search for meaning in life than to the presence of meaning in life. Conclusions: The knowledge gained can help women understand the specifics of child loss. It can foster a better understanding of their emotional states and experiences, especially in seeking psychological and spiritual help. It can be useful for psychotherapists, psychiatrists, and even pastoral workers, as well as others involved in providing support in situations after pregnancy loss.

stories.hook: ¿Los niños con TDAH presentan más discapacidades de aprendizaje?
stories.headline: Más del 60% de niños con TDAH tienen al menos una discapacidad de aprendizaje
stories.finding: En una muestra de 142 niños con TDAH, el 61,3 % presentaba al menos una discapacidad de aprendizaje, frente al 21,7 % de 131 controles. La odds ratio fue 5,72 (IC 95 % = 3,41‑9,58; p < 0,001), destacando la lectura como la comorbilidad más frecuente.
stories.takeaway: Este hallazgo subraya la necesidad de evaluar sistemáticamente discapacidades de aprendizaje en niños con TDAH, lo que permite intervenciones tempranas y personalizadas que mejoran el rendimiento académico y reducen el riesgo de fracaso escolar.
stories.paperTitle: Understanding the relationship between attention deficit hyperactivity disorder (ADHD) and learning disabilities in early childhood
stories.journal: International Journal of Childhood and Development Disorders
stories.originalAbstract: Consider a six-year-old who can't sit still in class and also struggles to read simple words. Is the reading problem a consequence of poor attention, an independent learning disability, or both operating through shared mechanisms? This research investigated the relationship between attention deficit hyperactivity disorder (ADHD) and learning disabilities (LD) in children aged 5 to 8 years in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia. A case-control design was employed, comparing 142 children diagnosed with ADHD to 131 age- and sex-matched typically developing controls recruited from 8 primary schools and 3 child development clinics between March 2022 and September 2024. Learning disabilities were assessed using the Woodcock-Johnson IV Tests of Achievement (Malay adaptation), and cognitive profiles were evaluated using the WISC-V, NEPSY-II, and the Conners Continuous Performance Test (CPT-3).Among children with ADHD, 61.3% met criteria for at least one learning disability, compared to 21.7% of controls (OR = 5.72, 95% CI: 3.41-9.58, p < 0.001). Reading disability was the most common comorbidity (34.2% in ADHD vs. 11.4% in controls), followed by math disability (27.8% vs. 8.7%) and written expression impairment (21.3% vs. 6.2%). Children with comorbid ADHD and LD showed a distinct cognitive profile characterized by markedly lower phonological awareness (mean = 68.4), sustained attention (71.8), and executive function (73.2) compared to both ADHD-only and control groups. Academic performance was most severely affected in the comorbid group, with reading comprehension scores averaging 28.1 points below controls (p < 0.001). Working memory emerged as the strongest single mediator of the ADHD-LD association, accounting for 34.8% of the indirect effect. These findings support a shared cognitive vulnerability model in which ADHD and LD are connected through common deficits in executive function, working memory, and processing speed, rather than representing entirely independent conditions.

stories.hook: ¿Cómo afecta la insatisfacción corporal al riesgo de depresión posparto?
stories.headline: La insatisfacción corporal y la presión social predicen la depresión posparto en madres nigerianas
stories.finding: En una muestra de 619 madres lactantes, la influencia del cónyuge (β = 0.46, p < .01) y de los padres (β = 0.17, p < .01) predijo significativamente la insatisfacción corporal, la cual a su vez mediaba la aparición de depresión posparto mediante comparaciones sociales y la internalización del ideal delgada.
stories.takeaway: Este hallazgo subraya la necesidad de intervenir en la presión social y la percepción corporal durante el posparto, orientando a profesionales a incluir estrategias de comparación social y de rechazo del ideal delgado para prevenir la depresión materna.
stories.paperTitle: Sociocultural Influence of Body Image Dissatisfaction on Postpartum Depression Among Nursing Mothers in Southwest, Nigeria
stories.originalAbstract: Abstract Introduction : Postpartum adjustment is a crucial developmental phase for new mothers, marked by intense physical, psychological, and sociocultural transitions. In contexts like Nigeria, sociocultural expectations around motherhood and ideal female appearance may heighten the risk of body image dissatisfaction and postpartum depression (PPD) among nursing mothers. Aims This study examined the sociocultural influences of body image dissatisfaction on postpartum depression while also ascertaining the mediating role of appearance-related social comparisons and thin-ideal internalization in the prediction of body image dissatisfaction and postpartum depression. Methods A convergent parallel mixed-methods design was used among 619 nursing mothers in Southwest Nigeria. Quantitative data were analysed using descriptive statistics, Pearson correlation, multiple regression, binary logistic regression, and mediation analysis. Qualitative data from in-depth interviews were analysed thematically to contextualize women's experiences of sociocultural influences on postpartum body image. Results Partner (β = 0.46, p < .01) and parent (β = 0.17, p < .01) influence were significant predictors of body image dissatisfaction, while peer and media influences were not significant. Sociocultural factors accounted for 25% of the variance in body image dissatisfaction. Body image dissatisfaction was strongly associated with postpartum depressive symptoms ( r = .76, p < .01) and remained significant after adjustment for relevant covariates (OR = 2.148, 95% CI: 1.838–2.510, p < .001). Mediation analysis revealed a significant indirect path through body image dissatisfaction (B = 0.131, 95% CI: 0.092–0.167), but thin-ideal internalization and appearance-related social comparison did not emerge as significant mediators. Furthermore, the study revealed that comments made by parent/family and partners were very prominent, along with expectations regarding weight and size of abdomen and the need to get back to the pre-pregnancy body. The abdomen was the most frequent vent of dissatisfaction, but some women subverted peer and media messages. Conclusion In the context of Nigeria, it was found that parental and partner support were particularly influential in determining postpartum body image. The findings are consistent with the Tripartite Influence Model and, through Symbolic Interactionism, illuminate women’s agency in negotiating socially constructed meanings of the body. Addressing sociocultural and body-image issues in postpartum mental health interventions may be beneficial for managing depressive symptoms

stories.hook: ¿Puede la eritropoyetina reparar el equilibrio neuronal?
stories.headline: EPO reduce la inhibición de interneuronas en el hipocampo de ratón
stories.finding: Se analizaron ~12,000 núcleos de transcriptómica unicelular del hipocampo de ratón, identificando 15 subtipos de interneuronas. La eritropoyetina recombinante alteró la expresión génica sináptica, reduciendo la complejidad dendrítica y la conectividad de interneuronas específicas.
stories.takeaway: Este hallazgo sugiere que la eritropoyetina puede modular el equilibrio excitatorio-inhibitorio en el hipocampo, ofreciendo una vía potencial para intervenir en trastornos psiquiátricos caracterizados por disfunción sináptica, como la esquizofrenia o el autismo.
stories.paperTitle: Erythropoietin restrains the inhibitory potential of interneurons in the mouse hippocampus
stories.originalAbstract: Severe psychiatric illnesses, for instance schizophrenia, and affective diseases or autism spectrum disorders, have been associated with cognitive impairment and perturbed excitatory-inhibitory balance in the brain. Effects in juvenile mice can elucidate how erythropoietin (EPO) might aid in rectifying hippocampal transcriptional networks and synaptic structures of pyramidal lineages, conceivably explaining mitigation of neuropsychiatric diseases. An imminent conundrum is how EPO restores synapses by involving interneurons. By analyzing ~12,000 single-nuclei transcriptomic data, we generated a comprehensive molecular atlas of hippocampal interneurons, resolved into 15 interneuron subtypes. Next, we studied molecular alterations upon recombinant human (rh)EPO and saw that gene expression changes relate to synaptic structure, trans-synaptic signaling and intracellular catabolic pathways. Putative ligand-receptor interactions between pyramidal and inhibitory neurons, regulating synaptogenesis, are altered upon rhEPO. An array of in/ex vivo experiments confirms that specific interneuronal populations exhibit reduced dendritic complexity, synaptic connectivity, and changes in plasticity-related molecules. Metabolism and inhibitory potential of interneuron subgroups are compromised, leading to greater excitability of pyramidal neurons. To conclude, improvement by rhEPO of neuropsychiatric phenotypes may partly owe to restrictive control over interneurons, facilitating re-connectivity and synapse development.
